provenance.batch01_source: H05 failure of imbalance-alone incremental value
provenance.h05_verdict: no MPIE/structural promotion in 45/45 cells for either orientation
provenance.novel_object: interaction between aggressive flow and contemporaneous price response
provenance.simpler_causal_baseline: taker imbalance + current price/volatility state on the exact same events

old_outcome_blind_design_source.used_only_as: outcome-blind scientific design provenance predating B2-02/B2-03/B2-04 outcomes

required_source_columns.verified_against: docs/manifests/CORE_BTC_BINANCE_V0.yaml raw_schema and availability_semantics, cross-checked against the exact accepted-parquet column names already read by scripts/research/h05_taker_imbalance_lib.py
required_source_columns.no_alternate_source: no quote_volume, trade_count, order-book proxy, another venue, another contract, or inferred CVD

chronology.last_legal_T_rule: T + H < 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z on the 15m grid; equality illegal; no truncation

flow.total: TOTAL_W = sum(base_volume) over accepted 1m rows wholly inside [T-W,T)
flow.taker_buy: TAKER_BUY_W = sum(taker_buy_base_volume) over the same rows
flow.malformed_row_policy: integrity/data failure for the affected record; fails closed
flow.direction: d = sign(IMB); UP-equivalent side is BUY if IMB>0, SELL if IMB<0

baseline_controls.rv: RV_W = sqrt(sum(r_1m^2)) over accepted 1m returns inside [T-W,T)
baseline_controls.role: baseline controls only, not candidate novelty

interpretation.large_positive: strong aggressive-flow imbalance accompanied by aligned price response
interpretation.near_zero: meaningful flow with weak aligned price response / absorption-like state
interpretation.negative: price moves opposite the aggressive-flow direction

impact_state.reference_rule: T_ref < T and T_ref >= T - 180 calendar days; finite IMPACT_INTERACTION known at T_ref; current record excluded
impact_state.historical_state_freeze: each historical state computed exactly once as-of its own T_e; never recomputed using later records
impact_state.expected_ordering: HIGH > MID > LOW for subsequent flow-direction-normalized outcome after baseline control

scale_reference.definition: PAST_MEDIAN_ABS_RET_H(T) = median(abs(ln(close(t+H)/close(t)))) over all canonical UTC 15m reference boundaries t in [T-30 calendar days, T) with t+H <= T
scale_reference.observation_population: the canonical aligned 15m grid, not B2-05 candidate/trigger records

forecast.refit_cadence: UTC ISO week start (Monday 00:00:00Z), held fixed through the week

training_window.rule: T_e < S and T_e >= S - 365 calendar days and T_e + H <= S

forecast.information_difference: candidate adds IMPACT_LOW and IMPACT_HIGH only
forecast.candidate_historical_eligibility: baseline-eligible row AND valid causal IMPACT_STATE AND both valid causal placebo nuisance bins (controls.nuisance_bins)
forecast.joint_unavailability: if either the baseline or candidate weekly model is unavailable, current scoring is unavailable for BOTH

preprocessing.transform: z = (x - training_mean) / training_std, using that model's own frozen causal training rows at S; identical frozen transform applied to that model's current-week scoring rows
preprocessing.column_standardization_source: each model's own training rows (baseline and candidate use their own, potentially different, training pools)
preprocessing.require_training_std: finite and strictly > 0 for every standardized continuous column
preprocessing.row_order: ascending CANONICAL_SCORE_RECORD_ID, applied before training statistics, matrix construction, fit, and audit hashes

ols_solver_contract.requirement: unweighted OLS, intercept included, no regularization, no column standardization escape, full column rank required, deterministic solve, no pseudoinverse, no fallback
ols_solver_contract.resolution: Gram-matrix Cholesky decomposition of X'X as the full-rank test, followed by np.linalg.solve(X'X, X'y) for the deterministic solve
ols_solver_contract.why_mechanical_not_material: on any well-posed (full column rank) design this produces the identical fitted coefficients, to numerical precision, as the old design's numpy.linalg.lstsq(rcond=None) with an explicit post-hoc rank check -- both accept exactly the same well-posed matrices and reject exactly the same rank-deficient ones; only the numerical PATH to that identical output differs, not the science. This equivalence (max |Cholesky-solve - lstsq| ~5.6e-13 across 120 random well-posed designs) was independently proven during the already-merged B2-04 implementation, which established this exact solver as current Batch02 canonical practice for a materially identical full-rank-only requirement (see scripts/research/b2_04_moderate_pullback_structure_lib.py::ols_fit).
ols_solver_contract.rank_deficient_or_nonfinite_behavior: fit unavailable; weekly model UNAVAILABLE_FOR_DECISION; no fallback

scoring_requirements: both frozen weekly models (baseline and candidate) available

canonical_base_serialization.used_for: construction, canonical row ordering, refractory-free identity, placebo pre-RNG sort

canonical_score_serialization.used_for: horizon evaluation; baseline and candidate share this identity

event_identity.integer_representation: plain base-10, no leading zero, no unit suffix
event_identity.side_representation: exactly BUY or SELL, uppercase ASCII

nuisance_bins.reference_rule: T_ref < T_e and T_ref >= T_e - 180 calendar days; current historical row excluded
nuisance_bins.boundary_assignment: exact boundary value belongs to the bin whose lower bound it equals; p=1.0 belongs to Q5
nuisance_bins.freeze: each nuisance quintile computed exactly once as-of its own T_e and stored; never recomputed
nuisance_bins.missing_bin_policy: candidate historical row ineligible; baseline historical eligibility unaffected if baseline fields and mature target are valid
nuisance_bins.purpose: make real-candidate and placebo-candidate training support identical; nuisance bins never enter the candidate design matrix

controls.permutation_scope: per causal weekly candidate fit, using exactly the real candidate's causal training rows
controls.permutation_target: historical stored IMPACT_STATE labels only; historical Y, baseline features, timestamps, row IDs, and nuisance bins fixed; evaluation event's own IMPACT_STATE fixed
controls.permutation_ordering: sort each stratum's real-candidate training rows ascending by canonical base event ID before RNG, then permute
controls.permutation_operation: permuted_labels = rng.permutation(input_label_vector); assign positionally back to the same sorted rows
controls.one_record_stratum: RNG instantiated, rng.permutation called on the one-element vector; label unchanged

seed_derivation_primitive.description: pipe-join str(part) for each ordered part, UTF-8 encode, SHA-256, take the first 8 raw digest bytes as a big-endian unsigned 64-bit integer

controls.current_T_representation: T_ms: integer UTC epoch milliseconds, identical representation to event_identity.canonical_base_serialization.interval fields
controls.week_start_ms_representation: integer UTC epoch milliseconds for Monday 00:00:00Z

placebo_failure_semantics.rule: a cell has a valid placebo_q95 only if all 100 nominal replicate cell statistics are finite
placebo_failure_semantics.single_event_failure_invalidates_whole_r: if a replicate fails to produce a finite statistic for even one scored evaluation event in the cell, the whole cell-level replicate for that index is invalid, not partially computed

controls.bootstrap_week_id: ISO week-numbering year and week (datetime.isocalendar(), UTC, decision time T); NOT the Gregorian calendar year
controls.bootstrap_week_sort: unique week IDs sorted ascending lexicographically (zero-padded ISO week number)
controls.bootstrap_rng: one numpy.random.default_rng(seed_int) per (W,H) cell; single generator stream for all 2000 replicates in ascending replicate order
controls.bootstrap_draw: rng.integers(0, n_week_blocks, size=n_week_blocks, dtype=np.int64) per replicate; concatenate selected whole week blocks in draw order, preserving within-week canonical order and block multiplicity
controls.bootstrap_statistic: mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT) over the pooled resampled observations
controls.bootstrap_one_block_behavior: n_week_blocks=1; every draw is index 0; the sole whole block is used once per replicate

primary_positive.note: the old outcome-blind design's primary_positive predicate is pooled-only; side symmetry is enforced separately by the side_stability gate, not duplicated here

bootstrap_positive.pooled_condition: 2.5th percentile of the 2000-replicate UTC-week bootstrap of mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT) > 0

placebo_separation.placebo_q95_definition: 95th percentile of the frozen 100 causal permutation replicates, valid only when all 100 are finite

impact_ordering.pooled_condition: median(BASE_RESIDUAL|LOW) < median(BASE_RESIDUAL|MID) < median(BASE_RESIDUAL|HIGH), all three states non-empty and finite

side_stability.definition: for EACH of BUY and SELL independently: mean(AE_IMPROVEMENT) > 0 AND median(BASE_RESIDUAL|HIGH) - median(BASE_RESIDUAL|LOW) > 0

promotion_gate_contract.horizon_robustness: for one W, the adjacent H pair (from [30,60],[60,120],[120,240]) has BOTH cells passing all six per-cell gates
promotion_gate_contract.parameter_robustness: the same adjacent H pair also passes all six per-cell gates for at least one other W; no single W may promote alone
promotion_gate_contract.year_stability: every cell in the qualifying neighborhood (the adjacent-H pair at both promoting W values, four cells total) has pooled mean AE improvement > 0 in at least 4 of 5 development years (2020,2021,2022,2023,2024); no year exclusions
promotion_gate_contract.neighborhood_definition: one adjacent-H pair crossed with exactly two distinct W values, producing four cells
promotion_gate_contract.neighborhood_enumeration_order: frozen H-pair order [30,60],[60,120],[120,240], then lexicographic ascending W-pair; select the first qualifying neighborhood
promotion_gate_contract.fail_closed_inputs: missing, unavailable, malformed, nonfinite, errored, empty-required-support, or non-literal-true mandatory evidence makes the corresponding gate false

forbidden_after_failure: no further taker-imbalance threshold child in current V2

durable_retention_integration.default_runner_acknowledgement_gate: outcome_access_acknowledged must be the literal boolean True, checked before any reservation/claim/loader call
